stars.msg: Take a deep breath. You're doing okay.
I love the way your mind works, even when it's tired.
Akii, I want you to know that you are more than enough.
Quiet time is okay. I'm just happy we share the same sky.
I appreciate how to keep your things up even you are tired.
If I could only lend you my heart and my eyes for a moment, you would see how much I truly appreciate your strength—and the natural beauty that shines through every time you smile.
You don't need to hold back your emotions when I'm with you.
If you're world gets heavy, always remember to rely someone you loved to carry some of your baggage.
Don't be afraid to name your emotions when you're in unstable mode.
